integrity: Exact symbolic checks of all residue-class polynomial coefficient identities and rational positivity coefficients were executed. The real-root count is derived using two sign changes and two sign crossings; root displacements follow explicit simple-root analytic expansions.
scientific_limitations: Concerns the eight roots of the diagonal numerator, not the full two-variable Bergman zero set; finite-parameter radical root forms and optimal higher-order error bounds are not claimed. Qualitative gap-four nonvanishing was already announced by Edholm--Mathew and is explicitly excluded from the new priority claim. Indexed related published-finding corpus full records were unavailable for direct material inspection. An unpublished continuation announced by the primary authors could overlap the root geometry.
title: Root topology and two-speed boundary condensation for gap-four Hartogs diagonals
